summary: This bill directs the Department of Veterans Affairs to provide stellate ganglion block treatment to veterans diagnosed with post-traumatic stress disorder who are enrolled in VA healthcare and elect to receive the treatment, and requires an update to clinical guidelines to include this therapy option.
